title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilites of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of May, June, and July, 1986. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred reasinable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company, and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 210 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
